name: StoneYield USD
oneLiner: stUSD is StoneYield's BNB Chain yield wrapper over USDC routed through a Venus-linked strategy layer; tracked as a managed wrapper, not a plain fiat stablecoin.
collateral: USDC and yield-bearing USDC positions routed through StoneYield's protocol contracts and Venus-linked strategy layer
pegMechanism: StoneYield wrapper token designed to maintain one-dollar accounting against deposited stablecoin assets while strategy yield accrues through the protocol's managed vault structure

blacklistabilityReview.evidence: Reviewed 2026-07-15. Current BSC safe-tag reads returned STUSD wrapper 0xb4d3c1bb59be7b419af4e10e9b240f425782b22a; its owner and STUSD DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE were 0x9ab82f8e97bf3202173b92e06e6593f336b76ccf, and wrapper susdcToken() was 0xad66385c6db496258771b5fd8ac376e3dd0d1536. These live reads are not archive-pinned: free RPC providers rejected explicit-block replay at 110064643 because historical state was unavailable. Verified STUSD source v2.0.1 uses the wrapper's getLockInfo(from) in _update and rejects a transfer that consumes an unexpired locked amount. Verified wrapper source v3.0.1 restricts wrapWithLock(to, amount, unlockTime) to its owner or OPERATOR_ROLE and creates the holder lock before issuing. No arbitrary lock of an already-held balance, token-level STUSD pause, or blacklist function was found; a current safe-tag paused() call reverted. This proves a direct possible holder transfer-lock surface, not a confirmed direct blacklist. The verified sUSDC implementation has pause, holder-lock, and burn controls; current safe-tag paused() was false and a non-persistent eth_call from its current owner to pause() succeeded. Those observations show live control, not a historical state snapshot. Issuer docs describe broader transfer restrictions than current STUSD code, so verified explorer source governs deployed behavior. No separate official ToS, proof-of-reserves publication, or archive capture was located in reviewed public materials; that absence was not used as access evidence.

mintAuthority.summary: stUSD is a StoneYield wrapper/share token over USDC and yield-bearing USDC positions, so base USDC mint authority is inherited from Circle. The StoneYield wrapper contract (0xb4d3c1bb…) separately holds MINTER_ROLE for stUSD issueFromWrapper; DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE is held by an EIP-7702 EOA (0x9ab82f8e…) delegating to 0x63c0c19a…. MAX_SUPPLY is a Solidity constant at 1B tokens.

controls.label: StoneYield stUSD wrapper contract (MINTER_ROLE / issueFromWrapper)
controls.capDescription: MAX_SUPPLY is a Solidity constant (≈1B tokens); issueFromWrapper() is gated by MINTER_ROLE and enforces MAX_SUPPLY ceiling.
controls.evidence: At BSC block 103632643, hasRole(MINTER_ROLE, 0xb4d3c1bb59be7b419af4e10e9b240f425782b22a) returned true; wrapper() on stUSD returned 0xb4d3c1bb…. Contract source (BscScan) confirms issueFromWrapper() requires MINTER_ROLE and checks MAX_SUPPLY; MAX_SUPPLY is a Solidity constant with no setter.

controls.label: StoneYield DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE (EIP-7702 EOA)
controls.evidence: At BSC block 103632643, hasRole(DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE, 0x9ab82f8e97bf3202173b92e06e6593f336b76ccf) returned true. eth_getCode on that address returned 23-byte EIP-7702 delegation designator (0xef0100 + 20-byte target 0x63c0c19a282a1b52b07dd5a65b58948a07dae32b); it is an EOA with EIP-7702 delegation. grantRole() is controlled by this EOA.

review.evidence: At BSC block 103632643: hasRole(MINTER_ROLE, wrapper 0xb4d3c1bb…) = true; hasRole(DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE, 0x9ab82f8e…) = true. wrapper() returns 0xb4d3c1bb… confirming the on-chain wrapper address. 0x9ab82f8e… is a 23-byte EIP-7702 EOA (delegation designator, not a Safe). MAX_SUPPLY() = 1B tokens (immutable constant). StoneYield docs confirm deposit mint path and admin rewardMint/pause/adminUnlock/sweepUSDC; base USDC mint authority is inherited from Circle because stUSD is tracked as a USDC strategy wrapper.

notices.title: Yield wrapper, not a plain cash stablecoin
notices.message: stUSD is tracked because CoinGecko returns a live price and market cap, but its structure is a managed yield wrapper around stablecoin strategies rather than a simple fiat-backed dollar token.
